metadata.title: OpenTUI Ink-parity messages and Thought visual slice

work.objective: Make the OpenTUI user, assistant, Thought and tool rows visually and semantically match the current Ink ConversationMessages/HistoryItemDisplay presentation while retaining the already validated OpenTUI mouse interaction.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.

Treat packages/cli/src/ui/components/messages/ConversationMessages.tsx, packages/cli/src/ui/components/HistoryItemDisplay.tsx, packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ToolStatusIndicator.tsx, packages/cli/src/ui/components/messages/ToolMessage.tsx and packages/cli/src/ui/constants.ts as the visual authority; they are read-only.

Only modify the four allowlisted OpenTUI message/model/test files; no backend, Ink, neutral streaming model, dependency, lockfile, Marshal-state, commit, push, publication, network or subagent changes.
Render user rows as an accent-colored > prefix and accent text with the Ink-equivalent two-column prefix reservation and turn spacing.
Render assistant rows with the accent-colored ◆ prefix, the same two-column content start, primary markdown body and Ink-equivalent turn spacing; do not add cards, borders or backgrounds.

Render Thought headers dim and italic: pending uses ∵ Thinking…; completed uses ∴ plus Thought briefly below 1000 ms or Thought for <formatted duration> at or above 1000 ms. Collapsed and expanded states must carry the same ctrl+o expand/collapse wording as Ink, with the click affordance included for the already mouse-enabled OpenTUI row.

Add the minimum OpenTUI-local model metadata needed to measure a Thought from its first thinking event until thinking-end. Keep foldLiveEvent deterministic under tests by accepting or otherwise exposing a controllable clock; do not modify backend or shared model APIs beyond the allowlist.
Expanded Thought content starts at the same two-column indentation and uses secondary/dim presentation. A collapsed completed Thought must not render its body.

Tool rows reserve exactly the Ink two-column status indicator width. Preserve the Ink glyph/status meanings and emphasis: pending o, executing ⊷, success ✓, confirming ?, canceled -, error x; status color, bold tool name, dim description and canceled strikethrough must match the readable Ink semantics available in the OpenTUI model.
Preserve click-to-expand behavior and selection safety. Do not regress assistant markdown streaming, tool args/result expansion, task rows, CJK/emoji width, or narrow wrapping.

Add focused tests that assert glyphs, two-column alignment, dim/italic attributes, Thought duration threshold and formatted labels, ctrl+o/click hints, collapsed-body behavior, tool status mapping and canceled strikethrough. Prefer pure metadata/model tests plus the smallest supported OpenTUI render test.
Do not duplicate a second message renderer in backend.tsx or broaden this slice into Header, Composer, LoadingIndicator, Footer or theme redesign.
Worker checks may use only the frozen acceptance commands. Do not mutate the Git index.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent input or report blocked.
context: The product baseline is feat/opentui-migrate after the accepted /help and Backspace fixes; no previously blocked or rejected Run may be copied or integrated.
The current OpenTUI messages.tsx already has the basic >, ◆, ∵/∴ and tool-card structure, but its completed Thought label omits Ink duration semantics and the slice lacks authoritative parity tests.

Ink completed Thought semantics are exact: duration below 1000 ms is Thought briefly; otherwise Thought for followed by formatDuration(durationMs). Collapsed VP text advertises click or ctrl+o to expand; expanded completed text advertises ctrl+o to collapse.

The backend-owned expanded Set and onToggle callback are the existing boundary for mouse/keyboard expansion state. This leaf slice must render both states correctly but must not change backend keyboard routing.
OpenTUI Text attributes use the installed renderer API; verify dim plus italic and strikethrough using supported attributes rather than ANSI escape strings.
nonGoals: No Header, Tips, Composer, LoadingIndicator, Footer or global theme work
No backend event source, input routing or ctrl+o key-handler changes
No dialogs, slash commands, VP architecture or mouse protocol changes
No release, commit, push or PR
